answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 4 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in tide, checked in shale, and comet exposes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 4389 identities would post 1131 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
